title: Build fn-tests-j5

proofs.run: sh -c 'WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR=$D/results python3 journeys/run.py J5 2>&1 ; python3 -c "import json,glob,collections as C;c=C.defaultdict(C.Counter);[c[r[\"step\"]].update([r[\"verdict\"]]) for f in glob.glob(\"$D/results/J5-*.results.jsonl\") for r in map(json.loads,open(f))];[print(\"STEP\",s,\",\".join(\"%s=%d\"%(k,v) for k,v in sorted(c[s].items()))) for s in sorted(c)]"'

proofs.pass: selftest: \d+ checks, \d+ mutants( red)?, .*0 not red or missing
proofs.fail: NOT RED|STRAY|NO MUTANT|NOT IN THE CATALOGUE|[1-9]\d* not red or missing

proofs.run: sh -c 'WHOOSH_THEME=dark WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR=$D/results-dark python3 journeys/run.py J5 2>&1 ; python3 journeys/lib/summary.py "$D/results-dark" J5'
proofs.fail: J5 (RED|COULD-NOT-DRIVE)|STEP J5\.\d+ [^\n]*(FAIL|NOT JUDGED)=|could not drive|THEME J5\.1 theme-applied (FAIL|NOT JUDGED)

proofs.run: sh -c 'WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR=$D/results-themes-dry python3 journeys/run.py --dry --themes light,dark J5 2>&1 | grep -E "^\[(light|dark)\] J5 "'

notes: Proof 0 runs J5 once on the hidden fixture core and prints, per step, the count of verdicts from the harness's results jsonl (journeys/lib/harness.py:248-270: one JSON line per case, verdict PASS|FAIL|NOT JUDGED); it prints 'STEP J5.n PASS=k' for a step with only passes (the inline python was tried on a sample file: 'STEP J4.1 PASS=2'). The pass regex needs all nine steps pure PASS; the fail regex catches any FAIL or NOT JUDGED in any step. journeys/run.py also prints 'J5 GREEN|RED|COULD-NOT-DRIVE: ...' on stderr (merged by 2>&1). Proof 1: journeys/J5.py --selftest runs the whole journey against the stand-in app of journeys/J4.py's kit (J5.py:437-445 loads it by path), prints 'selftest: N checks, M mutants red, ..., 0 not red or missing' (J4.py:899): no app. Mutant row for J5.1/chatgpt-stop-note is J5.py:377 ('the ChatGPT note is missing'); the app side is SettingsAIMacFeature.swift:32 where the row serves its note (needs an app rebuild). The J5 slice is 'slice-j5-agents' (docs/plan.json:3253); the journey mentions decision settings J5.8-J5.9 whose screens are items eecbf79a and others: a failing J5.8 is those items' gap, not this journey's. Theme (lane gap-themes): journeys/J5.py:208 calls `_theme.apply(s)` (journeys/lib/theme.py:20-24: `fixture theme <WHOOSH_THEME, default light>`, then the case `J5.1/theme-applied` reads uistate theme), TITLE says the theme (J5.py:66), MUTANTS row J5.py:375. Proof 2 runs the journey with WHOOSH_THEME=dark and prints, from journeys/lib/summary.py, the line 'THEME J5.1 theme-applied PASS got=dark'; the light pass is proof 0 (the default theme). Proof 3: `journeys/run.py --dry --themes light,dark J5` prints one line per theme ('[light] J5 ...', '[dark] J5 ...'; no app is launched, so the verdict word there is COULD-NOT-DRIVE and is not read). On a real run `--themes` writes each pass under <results folder>/<theme>/ and both passes drive one app (a fixture core cannot be reset): the lead launches once per theme, as proofs 0 and 2 do. A light run cannot show that the app applies a theme (a build that ignores the verb stays light): only the dark proof can.
